Name: D&D IEC Basic
Description: Built-in IEC-style electrical symbols (original artwork by D&D | Data&Development).
Author: D&D | Data&Development

Symbols.Name: Circuit breaker 1-pole
Symbols.Description: Miniature/moulded-case circuit breaker, 1 pole(s).

Symbols.Name: Circuit breaker 2-pole
Symbols.Description: Miniature/moulded-case circuit breaker, 2 pole(s).

Symbols.Name: Circuit breaker 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Miniature/moulded-case circuit breaker, 3 pole(s).

Symbols.Name: Circuit breaker 4-pole
Symbols.Description: Miniature/moulded-case circuit breaker, 4 pole(s).

Symbols.Name: Motor protection circuit breaker 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Motor protective circuit breaker with thermal (overload) and magnetic (short-circuit) releases.

Symbols.Name: Fuse
Symbols.Description: Fuse link / fuse holder.

Symbols.Name: Fuse 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Fuse link / fuse holder.

Symbols.Name: Residual current device 2-pole
Symbols.Description: Residual current circuit breaker (RCCB), 2 poles.

Symbols.Name: Thermal overload relay 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Thermal overload relay (main current path). Its auxiliary contacts 95-96 / 97-98 are drawn with contact symbols.

Symbols.Name: Contactor / relay coil
Symbols.Description: Operating coil of a contactor or relay. Contacts of the same device are cross-referenced automatically.

Symbols.Name: Timer relay coil (on-delay)
Symbols.Description: On-delay timer relay coil.

Symbols.Name: Contactor main contacts 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Main (power) contacts of a contactor. Associate with the coil by giving them the same device tag.

Symbols.Name: Contactor main contacts 4-pole
Symbols.Description: Main (power) contacts of a contactor. Associate with the coil by giving them the same device tag.

Symbols.Name: Auxiliary contact NO
Symbols.Description: Normally open auxiliary contact (e.g. 13-14).

Symbols.Name: Auxiliary contact NC
Symbols.Description: Normally closed auxiliary contact (e.g. 21-22, overload 95-96).

Symbols.Name: Change-over contact
Symbols.Description: Change-over contact (11 common, 12 NC, 14 NO).

Symbols.Name: Switch-disconnector 3-pole
Symbols.Description: Load-break switch-disconnector / main isolator.

Symbols.Name: Three-phase motor
Symbols.Description: Three-phase asynchronous motor with protective earth terminal.

Symbols.Name: Single-phase motor
Symbols.Description: Single-phase AC motor.

Symbols.Name: Single-phase transformer
Symbols.Description: Two-winding single-phase transformer (control transformer).

Symbols.Name: Three-phase transformer
Symbols.Description: Three-phase two-winding power transformer.

Symbols.Name: Power supply AC/DC
Symbols.Description: Switched-mode power supply, AC input, DC output.

Symbols.Name: Variable frequency drive
Symbols.Description: Frequency converter / variable speed drive for three-phase motors.

Symbols.Name: Soft starter
Symbols.Description: Electronic soft starter for three-phase motors.

Symbols.Name: Push button NO
Symbols.Description: Manually operated push button, normally open (start).

Symbols.Name: Push button NC
Symbols.Description: Manually operated push button, normally closed (stop).

Symbols.Name: Emergency stop push button
Symbols.Description: Emergency stop device: NC contact, mushroom head, latching (positive opening).

Symbols.Name: Selector switch 2-position
Symbols.Description: Rotary selector switch, maintained, NO contact.

Symbols.Name: Limit switch NO
Symbols.Description: Position (limit) switch with mechanical actuator, NO contact.

Symbols.Name: Proximity sensor (3-wire PNP)
Symbols.Description: Inductive proximity sensor, 3-wire DC, PNP output.

Symbols.Name: Photoelectric sensor (3-wire PNP)
Symbols.Description: Photoelectric (optical) sensor, 3-wire DC, PNP output.

Symbols.Name: Temperature transmitter (4-20 mA)
Symbols.Description: Two-wire temperature transmitter, 4-20 mA loop powered.

Symbols.Name: Pressure transmitter (4-20 mA)
Symbols.Description: Two-wire pressure transmitter, 4-20 mA loop powered.

Symbols.Name: Level switch
Symbols.Description: Float level switch, NO contact.

Symbols.Name: Indicator lamp
Symbols.Description: Signal / pilot lamp.

Symbols.Name: Horn / buzzer
Symbols.Description: Audible signalling device.

Symbols.Name: Solenoid valve coil
Symbols.Description: Electrically operated (solenoid) valve coil.

Symbols.Name: Socket outlet 2P+E
Symbols.Description: Socket outlet with protective earth contact (final circuit).

Symbols.Name: Heating element
Symbols.Description: Resistive heating element.

Symbols.Name: Terminal
Symbols.Description: Feed-through terminal of a terminal strip. Top (1) and bottom (2) are the same potential.

Symbols.Name: PE terminal
Symbols.Description: Protective earth terminal (green/yellow).

Symbols.Name: Protective earth
Symbols.Description: Protective earth connection. Defines the PE potential.

Symbols.Name: Potential feed
Symbols.Description: Named potential (L1, L2, L3, N, PE, +24V, 0V…). Identical names are connected throughout the project.

Symbols.Name: Interruption point
Symbols.Description: Interruption point / sheet connector. Points with the same name are connected; the cross-reference shows the counterpart.

Symbols.Name: Plug and socket
Symbols.Description: Plug-and-socket connector pin. Both sides are the same potential.

Symbols.Name: Device box (generic)
Symbols.Description: Generic device outline with four terminals, for devices without a dedicated symbol.

Symbols.Name: Digital input
Symbols.Description: PLC digital input channel. Address and PLC tag are taken from the assigned PLC channel.

Symbols.Name: Digital output
Symbols.Description: PLC digital output channel. Address and PLC tag are taken from the assigned PLC channel.

Symbols.Name: Analog input
Symbols.Description: PLC analog input channel. Address and PLC tag are taken from the assigned PLC channel.

Symbols.Name: Analog output
Symbols.Description: PLC analog output channel. Address and PLC tag are taken from the assigned PLC channel.

Symbols.Name: PLC power supply terminals
Symbols.Description: PLC / I/O module supply terminals (L+ / M).
